post-install-output: 1. In bin/console use Sillbeam\Core\Console\Application; instead of Symfony's Console Application.
Keep the existing bootstrap and Kernel, including import aliases; this enables Doctor before boot.
Never overwrite application files or force a recipe reinstall to apply these instructions.
2. Run php bin/console sillbeam:doctor and review action required and not verified checks.
Confirm the bundle in config/bundles.php and exactly one type: sillbeam route import
in config/routes/sillbeam.yaml (or your existing route configuration).
3. In services.yaml append Module and Project discovery roots to existing resource exclusions.
Preserve existing exclusions and explicit services; custom roots need their actual paths.
Make the reviewed changes yourself, then rerun php bin/console sillbeam:doctor.
4. Create a descriptor: php bin/console sillbeam:make:module Hello
Add the Greeting service and /hello controller from:
Run php bin/console sillbeam:architecture, then php bin/console debug:router hello.
